review: DAENEM Staff Portal Forms builder authorization-boundary review

findings.summary: Forms list, creation and review paths reused aggregate permission across companies and accepted unauthorized company filters.
findings.correction: Every company form operation now derives its scope from authoritative company-level forms permission; unauthorized targets fail closed.

findings.summary: Assignments could target foreign employees or roles and global group assignments accepted malformed company scope.
findings.correction: Employee membership and role company are validated before writes; global assignment is Owner-managed, global-form-only and company-null.

findings.summary: Personal assignments, review queues and offline idempotency replay could cross assignment or company boundaries.
findings.correction: Assignment reads repeat form and audience company scope; reviews require target-company approval; replay and updates repeat assignment and employee identity; denials are neutral.

reviewer.result: PASS for the bounded Forms builder security change; Workflow, Report, Widget and Theme builders plus authenticated V45 browser acceptance remain pending.
